acceptanceCriteria: Every fixture created by build_fixture.py contains a regular pending-parity-registry.json with schemaVersion 1 and entries [] unless a test explicitly populates it.
governance_integrity_gate_test.sh valid, archive-timestamp-current, awaiting-merge-close, and all negative cases pass with deterministic reports.
pending_parity_registry_test.sh passes all valid and adversarial cases, including duplicate/unknown/symlink/stale/foreign mutations.
No fixture test silently depends on a missing registry; failure diagnostics distinguish invalid registry from invalid Work Item state.
Tri-language Work Item and parity rows bind the exact implementation, verification, archive, finalization, and close evidence.
goal: 使所有治理 fixture 明确生成 schemaVersion=1 的空 pending parity registry，并让回归测试验证 registry 基线与合法/非法 pending 场景。
intent: 修复 governance integrity fixture 与 pending parity registry gate 的契约不一致，确保合法的 current archive/finalize fixtures 在缺少真实 pending registration 时仍能通过，并防止 hosted CI 再次因 fixture 自身缺少 registry 而 fail-open 或 fail-closed。
